notes.title: Beta_version_2.1.0
notes.content:
[h1]RELEASE NOTES[/h1]
This is applicable to both Windows and Mac version.

[h2]Steam Achievements[/h2]
-Players will now be able to unlock steam achievements for every level they complete. 
-There will be a total of 12 achievements, where each will unlock when you spot every single silly item in every level.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
-Cursor disappearing issue on Mac devices have now been solved.
-Tutorial section is more robust and straight forward.
